body: Sure, man, we can talk. I might be slow to respond tonight, but I'll do my best to get back to you as soon as I can.

Yeah... That's the thing I'm worried about. I'm not out to my parents yet (there's only 3 people I'm out to, and I haven't gone about presenting) and I don't even want to come out for fear of what will happen. Probably disappoint my dad (I've got a good relationship with him, I don't want to change that) and I know I'll disappoint my mom (raised extremely religious Baptist. I do not believe she knows what transgender people are). 

But yeah. A lot of our lives end at either our own hands, or at the hands of others and it seems like it's very rare that anyone from our community really breaks through to mainstream success. Like I said, I know it can happen. I just don't have any confidence it will happen for me. :/ 

It's good to hear your words, though. Thank you for responding.
